text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall despite several declines, but this short record does not show that holding or any particular strategy will keep working; avoid drawing strong conclusions from it.","Frequent checking can make ordinary fluctuations feel urgent, but with unpredictable prices, I should not trade merely to react to daily or monthly noise.","I should base each decision on my portfolio’s risk, diversification and plan—not on my average cost or the satisfaction of realizing gains or avoiding a loss."]}
